verdict.rationale: Auth0 ships an official, first-party Auth0 MCP Server, documented on its docs site and published in its GitHub repo. It connects AI agents and tools like Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Windsurf to an Auth0 tenant using OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization. Agents can then create apps, manage users, deploy Actions, and debug logs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Use the Auth0 MCP Server to manage your Auth0 tenant through natural language with AI tools, like Claude Desktop, using secure OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization.

The Auth0 Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server connects AI agents to your Auth0 tenant, allowing them to perform complex, multi-step operations in Auth0 such as creating applications, managing users, or deploying Actions.
Connect Claude, Cursor, or Windsurf to your Auth0 tenant to create apps, deploy Actions, debug logs, and manage users — all without touching the dashboard.
